                while st:

    def best_dir(o):
        cy=sum(y for y,_ in o['cells'])/len(o['cells']); cx=sum(x for _,x in o['cells'])/len(o['cells'])
        dr=mr-cy; dc=mc-cx
        if abs(dc)>=abs(dr) and dc!=0: return 'R' if dc>0 else 'L'

    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    # column fold: c->3+(2-c) for c<=2, c-2 for c>=3 (verified on demo1)

    # row fold toward center: g(r)=min(r,H-1-r)
    rf=lambda r: min(r,H-1-r)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=g[r][c]
            if v:
                or_,oc=v if False else (r,c)
                nr=rf(r); nc=cf(c)
                # only paint into left-half source region (c<7)

    out[0][3]=5

def feats(cells):
    rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs_=[c for _,c in cells]
    S=set(cells)
    w=max(cs_)-min(cs_)+1; h=max(rs)-min(rs)+1
    def run(n):
        seq=sorted(S, key=lambda p:(p[0]//w if False else 0))
        best=0; cur=1
        for i in range(1,len(S)):
            p=S[i]
            prev=S[i-1]
            d=(p[0]-prev[0],p[1]-prev[1])
            if abs(d[0])+abs(d[1])==1: cur+=1; best=max(best,cur)
            else: cur=1
        return best
    rh=run((1,0)); ch=run((0,1))
    diag=sum(1 for (r,c) in S if r-c==min(rs)-min(cs_) or c-r==0 and True)
    ad=sum(1 for (r,c) in S if r+c==(min(rs)+min(cs_)))
    sym_h=all((r,w-1-c) in S for (r,c) in S)

def shapes_of(din):
    H=len(din); W=len(din[0])
    div=[c for c in range(W) if all(r[c]==4 for r in din)][0]
    res=[]
    for c_,cs in comps_of(din):
        if c_ in (4,5): continue
        S=set(cs)
        r0=min(r for r,_ in S); c0=min(c for _,c in S)
        h=max(r for r,_ in S)-r0+1; w=max(c for _,c in S)-c0+1
        norm={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in S}
        rowcnt=[sum(1 for i,j in norm if j==j0) for j0 in range(w)]
        colcnt=[sum(1 for i,j in norm if i==i0) for i0 in range(h)]
        topfull = rowcnt[0]==w
        botfull = rowcnt[-1]==w
        colmax=max(colcnt)
        res.append(dict(color=c_,size=len(S),h=h,w=w,rowcnt=rowcnt,colcnt=colcnt,
                        topfull=topfull,botfull=botfull,colmax=colmax,
                        rmax=max(rowcnt),cmax=max(colcnt)))
    return res

import os,glob,re

files=glob.glob(d+'/../../sessions/*.jsonl')

# also find all grids regardless of header format: rows of digits after 'Test input' or 'Demo' headers anywhere
for f in sorted(files):
    txt=open(f).read().replace('\\n','\n')
    g=re.search(r'Test input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n', txt.replace('\\n','\n'))
    if g: print(os.path.basename(f), g[1])

# Gather per-object features for demo1 and test input, print them
def obj_feats(gin,gout=None,label=None):
    comps_ = comps(gin)
    res={}
    for i,sh in enumerate(comps_):
        if sh['n']==1 and gin[sh['ys0']][sh['xs0']]==5: continue  # marker
        f=dict(cells=sh['cells'],n=sh['n'],h=sh['h'],w=sh['w'],
              spans_r=(min(y for y,x,c in sh['cells']),max(y for y,x,c in sh['cells'])),
              spans_c=(min(x for y,x,c in sh['cells']),max(x for y,x,c in sh['cells'])),
              max_run_h=max(len(list(r)) for r in [[c for c in row] for row in np.array(gin)[sh['ys0']:sh['ys0']+sh['h']]]) if False else 0,
              rows_with_2=sum(1 for y in range(sh['ys0'],sh['ys0']+sh['h']) if sum(1 for x in range(sh['xs0'],sh['xs0']+sh['w']) if gin[y][x]==sh['cells'][0])==>=2),
              )
        # longest horizontal run
        arr=np.array(gin)[sh['ys0']:sh['ys0']+sh['h'], sh['xs0']:sh['xs0']+sh['w']]
        longest_h=0; longest_v=0
        for y in range(sh['h']):
            row=arr[y]; cur=0; best=0
            for x in range(sh['w']):
                if row[x]==arr[y][0] and cur==0: cur=1
                elif row[x]==arr[y][0]: cur+=1
                else: best=max(best,cur); cur=0
            best=max(best,cur); longest_h=max(longest_h,best)
        for x in range(sh['w']):
            col=[arr[y][x] for y in range(sh['h'])]
            cur=0; best=0
            for y in range(sh['h']):
                if col[y]==col[0] and cur==0: cur=1
                elif col[y]==col[0]: cur+=1
                else: best=max(best,cur); cur=0
            best=max(best,cur); longest_v=max(longest_v,best)
        f['longest_h']=longest_h; f['longest_v']=longest_v
        # rows containing >=2 cells
        f['rows2']=sum(1 for y in range(sh['h']) if (arr[y].count(arr[0]))) 
        # actually count cells per row
        rowcounts=[int((arr[y]==arr[0]).sum()) for y in range(sh['h'])]
        f['row_counts']=rowcounts
        res[label or i]=f
    return res

for k in ['Demo pair 1 input','Test input']:
    gi=G[k]; go=G.get(k.replace('input','output'))
    feats=obj_feats(gi)
    print('==',k)
    for lbl,f in feats.items():
        print(lbl,f['n'],f['h'],f['w'],'spans',f['spans_r'],f['spans_c'],'runs h,v',f['longest_h'],f['longest_v'],'rowcounts',f['row_counts'])

def f(inp):
    g=[r[:] for r in inp]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    div=None
    for c in range(W):
        if all(g[r][c]==4 for r in range(H)): div=c; break
    mk=None
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]==5: mk=(r,c); break
        if mk: break
    objs=[]
    for val in sorted(set(g[r][c] for r in range(H) for c in range(W))-{4,5}):
        for cl in comps_of(g,val):
            ys=[y for y,_ in cl]; xs=[x for _,x in cl]
            obj=set(cl)
            D=sum(1 for i in range(len(cl)) for j in range(i+1,len(cl)) if abs(cl[i][0]-cl[j][0])==1 and abs(cl[i][1]-cl[j][1])==1)
            bh=max(ys)-min(ys)+1; bw=max(xs)-min(xs)+1
            orient='V' if (bh>bw or bw==1) else 'H'
            # color6 vertical example: bbox 3x3 but vertical; orient iff height>width? use actual shape: V if it has a full vertical span of length >=2 adjacent columns... simpler: V if max contiguous vertical run >= horizontal equivalent AND touches left col? test: 6 cells (4,0),(4,2),(5,1),(6,1): rows contig runs: col0:1, col1:2,col2:1; h: row0:1,1,row1:1,row2:1 -> equal. Use rule: V if touching left edge else H
            tleft=min(xs)==0
            orient='V' if (bh>=bw and tleft) else 'H'
            objs.append(dict(color=val,n=D+'', top=min(ys), left=min(xs),orient=orient,bh=bh,bw=bw))
    objs.sort(key=lambda o:(o['left'],o['top']))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    mc = 2*div - mk[1]
    out[mk[0]][mc]=5
    # place first bar: below marker column at row mk[0]+1
    cur_r,cur_c=mk[0]+1,mk[1]
    placed=set()
    for o in objs:
        if o['orient']=='H':
            n=int(o['n'])
            if len(objs)>1:
                rr=cur_r; cc=cur_c-n+1
            else:
                rr=cur_r; cc=cur_c
            if n<=W-1-max(0,cc-0): pass
            for j in range(n):
                c2=cc+j if len(objs)>1 else cc+n-1-j
                if 0<=c2<W: out[rr][c2]=o['color']
            if len(objs)>1: cur_r,cur_c=rr,cc+n-1
            else: cur_r,cur_c=rr+1,cc-1
        else:
            n=o['n']
            # anchor bottom to previous tip above
            bot=min(cur_r,n-1)
            top=bot-n+1
            for y in range(top,bot):
                if 0<=y<H: out[y][cur_c]=o['color']
            cur_r,top=bot-1,top
            # extend left/right? leave cur_c
            # move cur down by n
            cur_r+=n
    return out

G=load()
def feats(v,g='Demo pair 1 input'):
    pts=sorted(next(c for c in comps_8(g,v)))
    ys=[p[0] for p in pts]; xs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    s=set(pts); mh=min(ys); mc=min(xs); bh=max(ys)-mh+1; bw=max(xs)-mc+1
    F=dict(n=len(pts),bh=bh,bw=bw)
    F['D']=sum(1 for i in range(len(pts)) for j in range(i+1,len(pts)) if abs(pts[i][0]-pts[j][0])==1 and abs(pts[i][1]-pts[j][1])==1)
    F['OH']=sum(1 for i in range(len(pts)) for j in range(i+1,len(pts)) if (pts[i][0]==pts[j][0] or pts[i][1]==pts[j][1]) and abs(pts[i][0]-pts[j][0])+abs(pts[i][1]-pts[j][1])==1)
    # enclosed holes: bg cells in bbox with no path to bbox edge through bg (4-conn)
    bg=[(y,x) for y in range(mh,mh+bh) for x in range(mc,mc+bw) if (y,x) not in s]
    seen=set(); stack=[]
    for b in bg:
        if b in seen: continue
        comp=[b]; seen.add(b); q=[b]
        while q:
            y,x=q.pop()
            for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                n=(y+dy,x+dx)
                if mh<=n[0]<mh+bh and mc<=n[1]<mc+bw and n not in s and n not in seen:
                    seen.add(n); q.append(n)
        if len(comp)==1 and len(q)==0: F['enc']=[comp]; continue
    F['holes']=len(seen-bg) if False else 0
    # count bg cells in bbox NOT reachable from border bg (4-conn bg region containing border bg)
    border_bg=[b for b in bg if b[0] in (mh,mh+bh-1) or b[1] in (mc,mc+bw-1)]
    reach=set(border_bg)
    q=list(border_bg)
    while q:
        y,x=q.pop()
        for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            n=(y+dy,x+dx)
            if mh<=n[0]<mh+bh and mc<=n[1]<mc+bw and n not in s and n not in reach:
                reach.add(n); q.append(n)
    F['holes']=len(bg)-len(reach)
    return F
for v in (1,6,2,3):
    print(v,feats(v))
print('target len', {1:3,6:2,2:2,3:4})
